vb_textbox.text: Try and find a pattern quickly and stick with that until the number of mushrooms decreases and lulls. I found the vibrant coloured gnomes harvested the highest amount and when the number changed I would then go to the duller green/brown gnomes until they lulled. For 5 rounds it seemed the gnomes with the taller hats harvested the most so this may be in play too however to begin I would focus on colour and gage whether the purple/red ones or brown/green ones harvest more and follow that pattern until the mushroom amount decreases. Also make sure to revisit patterns as it seemed to come back round
